content.description:
Use DropCNFT calendar to follow all NFT projects on the Cardano Blockchain and stake your ADA safely. Earn ADA, get DCNFT Tokens and try to win CNFTs randomly!

As DropCNFT delegator you can randomly win CNFTs. You’ll also receive DCNFT tokens each epoch: 1 ADA staked = 1 DCNFT Token (limited to 1,000,000 DCNFT per epoch). Project owners who need promotional banner get 20% discount. DCNFT tokens can be use to pay this ads as below : 20,000 DCNFT = 1 ad day. DropCNFT is the best pool for all CNFT lovers and CNFT project owners.

Go to EasyCNFT website and select DCNFT project. There is a total of 18 NFTs minted with unique value. It can be between 10,000 and 900,000 DCNFT Tokens value. The randomly generated CNFTs will cost 40 ADA each. Then you’ll can hold it, resale it or change it against DCNFT Tokens.

Our second drop will allow you to get discount forever ! It’ll cost 40 ADA to get randomly one Cardano NFT with unique percentage. It’ll can be between 10% and 90%. Then you’ll can hold it to get ads discount until you sell it
